name: Diskking 670 Compressor
description: Diskking 670 Compressor: The Disk King's variation on the Fairchild 670, the classic two-channel variable-mu tube limiter, for the MPC. Stepped input gain, threshold, six time constants, Left-Right or Lat-Vert (mid/side), balance thump and gain-reduction meters.
author: The Disk King
